notes.title: New update for Prison Simulator is on the way!
notes.notes:
Welcome Players and Officers!

How are you guys? 
We gladly announce that another   update for Prison Simulator is on the way!

What will be in this update? 
Besides some standard bug fixes and some improvements to the gameplay we will add completly new game mode  !

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/063310d8fca242336a88a79a59a136693a19c5b2.jpg

Last Man Standing Mode - what is it about?

A completly new separate game mode - Last Man Standing - the player is alone in a new prison which is a set of rooms and corridors. 
This prison is undergoing a huge rebellion - chaos reigns around! 
The player must get out of prison in one piece.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/edecb53d3fdb164c363e92309c1b5f7c9d52e491.gif

This new mode will be heavily action-oriented. We can show you some of the early works. Don't worry this prison won't be so empty and white ;) it's just a testing ground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/a1432707766f32e4310a7aa996e426177d3cb2c1.gif

Find you way throu maze of corridors! Be aware that you have only small quantity of ammo and weapons! But you can find some items on the way!

You can treat this new mode like a prologue to the Ready for Riot game. 
Remember about this one? We are still working on it ;)

Welcome Players and Officers


Time has come! We gladly introduce you a big FREE update to Prison Simulator!
We were working hard to fix all bugs that you were reporting and also we added some most demanded stuff like new routinies and activities!
So... Are you ready ?
What can you expect in this update?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba79442baa3582ebc63928bb3af1ffc760943a93.png


THREE NEW ROUTINES

Nightshift 
Be ready for some thrilling actions at prison at night! Well maybe not so many action but a lot can happen during night. Maybe even someone will try to break out of prison? And what if you spot a ghost? Spooky!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif

TV Room 
Never ever seen before new routine! Select some prisoners you want to give some chill time in

notes.notes:
Hello there dear players!


How was your holidays and New Year Eve? Mine was fine but now it's time to do some stuff!
Remember, we are preparing a really big update for you !
Be ready for the end of January to receive new cool stuff in your favourite Prison Simulator game!
What will be in this update? Check out below and also feel free to check past devlogs on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba79442baa3582ebc63928bb3af1ffc760943a93.png

ABSOLUTELY NEW ROUTINE! NIGHTSHIFT

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/339063358f29df0db0b1c078372994c714886926.gif

Be ready to visit your beloved work place at night!
It was a popular player's demand to add some new routines and we thought that visting a prison at night can be cool and creepy. Just look at this slow walk, these shady lights, creepy old corridor and a ghoulish ghosts cries? Brrr... Maybe next time i should take a day shift.

Nightshift in Prison Simulator: what are your responsibilites?

Take a walk
At night a lot can happen so be on your guard!
There are some basic stuff like go around and mark a suspicious things like cracks in the walls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/c9b4116855e3a95be7572684e2eeae1afe4987ff.gif

New hiding places
Now you can search for contrabanda some new things like tables in canteen room.
Damned inmates! Why they are wanna hide some things here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/822a8b530d2a64b17c29dbe1e5756cefdfe42191.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1800cc3470b50aa06982ff40a034e44ac767a8f4.gif

Visit some old friends
Gonna check block B for any suspicious behavior.
Luckily there is a least one additional guard so he can help if anything happen...
Most of prisoners just sleep at night. Most of them...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/8be66feefb8e18352fa09542645a003c8b4d2783.gif

Catch wandering inmates!
Whoa what is this? How did you escaped your cell and what are you doing here?! Well, no time to explain come with me to the isolation ward!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/79c5d48378368932c2402876d83aa32cdedb11b1.gif

Put the fire out!

Aaaah! What now!? A fire?! At least i can see it clearly at night. I think someone has helped this fire to lit but no evidence yet... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/1dbb8aba11e6140b8a136b225eac2e8e4ac0ac9d.gif

Enjoy the view

So what you think about this new routine? 
It have some atmosphere, right? Maybe we should do a horror game next... Like escape from haunted prison. Hey that's a nice idea actually!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/ba1614fc0a75c00f0fe035dcf6fe1da203474faf.gif


That's all for today. Be ready for some next Devlogs soon and for BIG update at the end of January.
Also you have a chance to get a Prison Simulator with 15% discount at this moment! Be quick because Steam Winter Sale ends soon!

It is the time to take a look at Free Time.

A few days ago we asked you what do you think about our demo. 
Your feedback is the most important for us, because without it we don't know what exactly we should improve. 

Today, we want to focus on Free Time. Some of you said there are not many mini games, you have to do always the same and the longer you play the more boring it is. 

In our demo you don't have access to all features. 
You could visit shooting range, play darts and lift weights.

We want to tell you a bit more about activities, that will be available in full version.


1, Weapons cleaning

This mini game will be available in the shooting range. when the gun gets dirty, it may not work properly. On the shooting range you will find a special stand that will make the cleaning process easier. You will find there cloths, ramrod and all necessary tools. We are also working on different weapons to make this mini game interesting and various.

2. Lock picking

Sometimes prisoners like to destroy something. One of their favorite activities is clogging locks. Your task is to get rid of the problem. Can you do it? You need to get inside the lock to be able to fix it.

3. Clogged showers

During the shower routine one of the prisoners decided to push something into the shower headset. Great idea, You have to take care of it now. Remember to look well. Sometimes it is just sabotage and sometimes it is a great opportunity to hide something illegal.

4. Fix a broken camera

As a guard you want to know everything and see everyone. With the help of cameras it is even easy. But sometimes the cameras get damaged, hang up or just refuse to cooperate. Find a broken camera and look inside to fix it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/2a7d57e4225c9f099f5f3a89d8ee80818157aed3.png

They have gained a new user interface, 3D preview and a panel in the journal, which allows you to check the progress and discover tips which will help you with the next items. The reward system has also been improved. For finding all 10 collectibles the player receives:

Shakedown routine

Hello guys! Welcome to our next update. 10th. Nice number. Today we're going to tell you a little bit about searching the cells and looking for illegal items called contraband.

When you go to the cell you have few places to check. Sink, toilet and a bed. Remember that one object can be checked in different ways. For example if you exmine a sink you have to search the tap and the part under the whole object. You don't know if someone didn't hide something there.

notes.title: Update#4 Summary of the day
notes.notes:
When the day is coming to an end, you must go to the briefing room. There you will see a summary of most of your expenses and how your decisions have influenced the respect of both the convicts and your colleagues.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33433455/7e40e833c876c2c054e3b83bcfd5a55f9f7edc86.jpg

First of all, the summary allows you to analyse which of your actions were considered to be commendable, or quite the opposite. This will help you in the future to keep an eye on your decisions when it comes to resolving a conflict or fulfilling someone else's request. Which side will benefit and which side will suffer? Is it better to keep up your spirit among your colleagues today, or can you afford to get closer with prisoners?

Nevertheless, the financial aspect is crucial, too. You get your daily wage every day. It's your private money that allows you to buy the necessary items for your everyday work... or to bribe someone. But, besides your private money, you also have the prison budget at your disposal. You can use those funds only to buy some things to improve the facility.

If you wonder why a rank-and-file warden has an access to the prison budget...you'll see about that in due time.
